scope: Parcel evidence checks and preparation of corrections to filed CAP applications, not a legal eligibility or filing-permission engine.

beneficiary_responsibility.title: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1173
beneficiary_responsibility.review_note: Beneficiary responsibility includes automatic claims. Per-value app review is an implementation safeguard, not a prescribed statutory UI.

prefill_correction.title: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1173
prefill_correction.review_note: National correction deadline and guiding alerts; correcting local prefill is not official filing.

maximum_eligible_area.title: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1172
maximum_eligible_area.review_note: Member State determines maximum eligible area using national criteria, ineligible elements and possible margin. A locally computed polygon area is a distinct technical measurement.

parcel_identity.title: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1173
parcel_identity.review_note: Unambiguous parcel identity must come from supplied evidence; private app identity is not automatically an authority ID.

claim_delineation.title: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1173
claim_delineation.review_note: Declared intervention area may be smaller than total parcel area. Overlap is a discrepancy for review, not by itself a finding of fraud or ineligibility.

crop_evidence.title: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1173
crop_evidence.review_note: Crop is relevant where required. Do not infer a legally confirmed crop from imagery or a previous year.

protected_area_context.title: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1172
protected_area_context.review_note: Protected-area location is recorded context, not automatic eligibility or a blanket prohibition.

correction_deadline.title: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1173
correction_deadline.review_note: The Member State sets and communicates the deadline; it must be no later than 15 calendar days before the first instalment. This EU ceiling is not a verified national deadline.

ams_correction.title: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1173
ams_correction.review_note: AMS branch restricts specified non-monitorable breaches found outside AMS/administrative checks and amendments after notification of an intended on-site check.

other_correction.title: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1173
other_correction.review_note: Other-intervention branch covers announced checks and awareness from unannounced on-site checks, with an exception for the part unaffected by detected non-compliance. Locked input does not establish unannounced-check awareness.

animal_correction.title: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1173
animal_correction.review_note: Animal branch includes a separate identification/registration cutoff and automatic-claim withdrawal rules; outside this parcel-focused evaluator.

administrative_or_ams_finding.title: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1173
administrative_or_ams_finding.review_note: Administrative/AMS findings do not impose a blanket bar; affected-part correction follows the branch conditions. Authority corrections require beneficiary awareness and opportunity to disagree.

official_channel.title: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1173
official_channel.review_note: Actual amendments/withdrawals use national official communication channels. Preparation and app approval are not transmission or acceptance.

ams_response.title: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1173
ams_response.review_note: Actual authority information can be answered by Article 7 amendment or additional evidence; public imagery alone is not an authority AMS finding.

rules.national_deadline: Never invent a Member State deadline or treat the EU first-instalment-minus-15 ceiling as the national deadline.
rules.notice_scope: Do not apply animal/other unaffected-part exceptions to the AMS branch by analogy.
rules.preparation: may_prepare authorises no official amendment, withdrawal or submission; all outputs are source-backed preparation guidance only.
rules.missing_parameters: Country, intervention, applicable national rule, control-stage evidence and official channels require separate human review. A source pointer is provenance, not verification of its legal contents.
rules.original_filing: filed_on is a supplied original filing date, not evidence that the authority received or accepted a filing.

limits: Primary indexed English bodies reviewed; direct HTTP reader was challenge-blocked. Consolidation labels do not independently verify every amending act's commencement.
No national deadline or rule set is installed here.
No universal legal eligibility, payment estimate, financial-loss statistic or Natura decision.
Rule version 1 follows the indexed consolidations checked 17 October 2026; refresh and national review remain separate.
